authority.intent_sender: NativePoiSite sends canonical source/object/action identity, owner-issued run/site context, observed revisions, and the actor's observed local approach only.
authority.run_and_phase_owner: A0.RunLifecycle alone issues run_id, run_epoch, phase_id, site_instance_id, and phase projection revisions.
authority.transaction_owner: A0 independently resolves canonical A1 identity and the exact A3-approved binding, validates physical access and commits through existing SaveService.
authority.economy_owner: A3 owns rewards, costs, inventories, wallets, vendor/recycler policy and source authorization; A0 performs the authorized atomic save transaction.
authority.save_owner: A0 SaveService; A8 scene keeps no durable state.

identity: intent_id = source_id | object_id | action_id | claim_id | run_id | site_instance_id | run_epoch | phase_id | observed_phase_projection_revision | observed_projection_revision. It is an untrusted idempotency hint; A0 independently validates/deduplicates every value.
request_rules: A8 sends neutral identity and observed physical approach only. It sends no costs, rewards, cooldown duration, claim policy, capability grant, state delta, unlock duration, catalog_source, approval reference, provisional_test_only/client authority flag, currency delta, item delta, balance, receipt, or save patch.

A0 validates run_id, run_epoch, phase_id, site_instance_id, both observed revisions, canonical A1 source identity, actor world position/facing, current active run, and physical access against trusted world state; client position is evidence to check, not authority.

A0 independently resolves the exact A3-approved binding, price, reward, capability, active-time cooldown, generation, exclusive choice and durable transaction key from trusted owner data. Unknown identities and unrecognized request fields fail closed.

No A3-approved A8 site/action binding currently exists. A0 must reject all three sites' material transactions until A3 publishes and A0 validates a source-bound approval; a neutral request is not approval.

One atomic A0 SaveService transaction couples any authorized debit/credit, claim ledger, cooldown/generation, site state, delayed action unlocks and receipt; no scene-supplied amount or client flag participates.
World state and visible results change only after A0 returns a committed receipt and newer owner projections. Interrupted/rejected operations do not mutate A8 state; retries remain owner-idempotent.

Fixture economics and test receipts live only in tests/fixtures/survival/world_content/a8_native_poi_action_catalog.fixture.json and the test-only PoiAuthorityFixture. They are not A3 bindings, A0, or SaveService.

run_phase_projection.missing_or_unavailable: no phase-specific geometry, no mutating intent, no scene transition
run_phase_projection.stale_or_malformed: reject without mutating the site or run

owner_projection_contract.status: A8 test-fixture contract; A0 approval required before production
owner_projection_contract.identity: source_id must equal the canonical A1 POI ID for the receiving scene; no local scene ID or client-selected replacement identity is accepted.
owner_projection_contract.revision: projection_revision is a non-negative, monotonically increasing owner revision persisted through the existing A0 SaveService transaction. Equal revisions are idempotent only when projection payloads are identical; older or conflicting same-revision projections are rejected.
scene_rules: A8 never increments revisions or synthesizes durable state.
A8 rejects projections for another POI, malformed required values, stale revisions, and conflicting payloads that reuse a revision.
After a committed result, a missing/stale projection is not rendered as success; the scene requests an owner refresh.
Fixture revision persistence is a serialized test harness only and is not evidence of production SaveService persistence.
